text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Norwegian premier Thorbjorn Jagland is on a visit to Estonia and expressed support to Estonia's security concerns and reforms.
- The agreement between the Centre and Coalition parties of November 14 was published yesterday.
- President Lennart Meri told the German press that Estonia wants to conclude the border agreement with Russia as soon as possible.
- Former finance ministry chancellor Enn Pant became director general of the shipping line 'Hansatee'.
- The families of Estonia ferry victims and surviving crew members have received their first compensation payments from insurance firms.

- Small investors have earned 17,000 kroons on the shares of the Estonian Gas. Fatherland Union chairman Toivo Jurgenson has made a profit of 360,000 kroons and he refuses to sell the shares although the state audit office recommended it.
- Parliament completed the first reading of the law on excise tax on packaging, meant to protect local brewers' market share.
